mapper.select: select a.id, a.owner_user as ownerUser, a.username, a.label_name as labelName, a.group_id as groupId, a.crt_time as crtTime, b.pic, b.nickname from t_chat_users a, t_register_users b where a.owner_user = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.username = b.username order by a.crt_time asc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into t_chat_users (owner_user, username, label_name, group_id, crt_time) values (#{ownerUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{labelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0', now())
